purpose: Arbitrary-radix input representation, independent convolution identity and actual fifteen shifted additions recover the exact full product from coefficient buffers.
caller_boundary: assemble_exact requires fifteen input-defined coefficients; the next full composition must obtain them from the actual interpolation module.
domain: Full-u64 equal-length inputs7*k<=n<=8*k including empty input; contiguous output2*n words.
space: No additional scratch for recomposition beyond caller-owned coefficient buffers and output.
analytic_work: Fifteen existing shifted additions: O(n) for this fixed arity, not a checked machine-cost theorem.
runner_boundary: Ordinary harness validates structural shapes; Python independently supplies all fifteen true input-convolution coefficients. Numeric coefficient correctness is an explicit formal caller obligation, not a runtime parser check.
